description: REPAIRED the probe: observe.sh was emitting probe_total=null for 24 runs because probe.sh (a) ran `pi -p` which prints plain text (not NDJSON) — needed `--mode json`, (b) wrote to bench/out/ instead of .scratch/bench-results/, (c) regex looked for input_tokens vs pi's actual input field. Fixed probe.sh to emit NDJSON and parse message_end usage. Now observe.sh captures probe_total=6258 (cached floor). Durable edit via ctx_shell (write tool confined to project root).

asi.hypothesis: Repair probe.sh so observe.sh emits a real probe_total (it was null for 24 runs: pi emits NDJSON only with --mode json; probe regex looked for input_tokens but pi outputs input; probe wrote bench/out/ not .scratch/bench-results/)
asi.root_cause: probe binary produces NDJSON with --mode json (message_end.usage.input/...); old probe used plain -p (output 'pong'), wrote wrong path and wrong field names
